author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
If you are interested in a train ride check huayunluxurytrains.com and do not forget to mention our code word "Baobao" for extra perks! 

Join us on an unforgettable journey aboard China’s most luxurious train: the Silk Road Express. 
In this video, we travel from Xining to Dunhuang, crossing some of the most breathtaking landscapes in western China. From the Tibetan monasteries of the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau to the otherworldly salt lakes of the Qaidam Basin, this train journey feels like stepping into another world.
Along the way, we follow the path of the ancient Silk Road, ending in the legendary desert oasis of Dunhuang, a place once crossed by Marco Polo hundreds of years ago.
This is more than just a luxury train ride. It’s a journey through history, culture, and some of China’s most remote and stunning scenery.
